day_local: Mvulo Weveki Yamashumi Amathathu Kwixesha Eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo nenceba kaThixo kulo lonke usapho lwenu namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, ube nenceba nathi.
Kristu, ube nenceba nathi.
Nkosi, ube nenceba nathi.
psalm_response: Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu ethile ekuvukeni kwakusasa apho ilizwe lisathi cwaka, lingenazintswana zininzi, kwaye ukukhanya kokuqala kwelanga kucanda ngesango elifakelwe ifestile yakho. Ngamanye amaxesha kuloo mzuzu, ngaphambi kokuba ihlabathi livuke ngokuphelele, ucinga ngomntu owayemile ecaleni kwakho, umntu owayehlala enezinto ezininzi zokuthetha, okanye mhlawumbi owawuhlala umbukele xa ehamba ngesantya sakhe sokwazi izinto. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyithanda kakhulu le mihlaba yokufunda—engengokufunda kwiincwadi kuphela, kodwa nangokubona ukuba indalo nendlela izinto ezisebenza ngazo zibonakalisa njani ubukhulu bukaThixo. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo izinyoni, indlela awayehlala ehleka kwaye egigitheka ngayo xa ethetha ngale 'con chim airlines' yakhe eyayingcamango yakhe emsulwa, eyonwabisayo. Wayengenguye nje umntwana odlalayo; wayeyindoda encinci eyayinezixhobo zokuqonda ikamva, eyayibona ukuba ubomi bunokubhabha kude, bunokufikelela kwiindawo ezintsha, kwaye bunokuba yinto enkulu kunokuba singayicinga apha emhlabeni. UBen wayengumfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu, enqwenela ukubona izinto zihamba kakuhle kwabo bonke abamngqongileyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usixelela into ecacileyo kakhulu: 'Nibe nobubele omnye komnye, nibe novelwano, nixolelelane njengoko uThixo wanixolelayo kuKristu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Awuthi uThixo wasikhangela kuphela esenza kakuhle. Uthi uKristu wasithanda wazinikela ngayo yonke into ngenxa yethu. UBen wayeyazi le nyaniso ngendlela yakhe ethuleyo kodwa enamandla. Khumbula loo mfanekiso mhle wosapho lapho uBen, eneminyaka eli-15 nje kuphela, wathetha nabazali bakhe ngokuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo emibini. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi, kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango. Loo mnikelo wawungumfanekiso wothando lukaKristu olungaphezulu kolwazi. UBen wayengumfana owayengalindi ukuba izinto zenzeke; wayeyindoda encinci eyayithatha inyathelo lothando ngaphandle kokuzigcina nto.

Kodwa ukuthetha ngothando olunjalo kusizisa kwelinye icala lobomi, kwicala eliba nzima ukulithwala ngamanye amaxesha. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, sibona uYesu efundisa kwindlu yecawa ngomhla wesabatha, apho kukho umfazi owayegobe iminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo, engakwazi ukuma ngqo ngenxa yesifo esamthwalisayo nzima. UYesu uyambona, uyamemeza, kwaye uthi kuye: 'Wazihlangula esifweni sakho.' Umfazi uyama ngqo, kwaye uyazukisa uThixo. Kodwa umphathi wendlu yecawa uyacaphuka ngenxa yokuba uYesu enze oku ngomhla wesabatha. Uyabona ukuba abantu bahlala bekhathazwa yimigaqo yabo kunye neenkxalabo zabo, ngoxa uThixo yena ekhathazwa kukukhulula abantu ababuthathaka.

Apha ke, kulapho ubomi bethu buqubisana khona nenyaniso enzima. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Nceda ukhumbule ukuba uRyan, nawe mntwana okhoyo apha, umntwana okhuliswe ngothando olukhulu, uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke ababhubhileyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni naseoxolweni likaKristu.
Sikhulekela bonke abasezintlungwini nabazileyo, ukuba uThixo abaduduze abanike ithemba elingenasiphelo.

readings.label: Isifundo Sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, nibe nobubele omnye komnye, nibe novelwano, nixolelelane njengoko uThixo wanixolelayo kuKristu. Ziphatheni njengoThixo, njengabantwana abathandekayo, niphile eluthandweni, njengoko uKristu Wasithanda wazinikela ngenxa yethu njengesibiya esinika ivumba elimnandi kuThixo. Ukuba yimpama, okanye ukungcola nokuhaba mavingakhankanywa nani, njengoko kufanele abngcwele, kunye namanyala nokuthetha ubudenge okanye ukugculela, okungafanelekanga, kodwa kunye nombulelo. Qinisani ngokuthi akukho namnye umntu oyimpama, okanye ongcolileyo, okanye ohabayo, oyingcwaliso losapho lwamalungelo, onelifa eBukumkanini bukaKristu noba nguThixo. Makungabi namnye ukudukisayo ngamazwi angenanto, kuba ngenxa yezi zinto umsindo kaThixo uza kubabetha abangatoreshiyo. Ngoko ke musani ukudibana nabo. Kuba nibe ningumnyama ngaphambili, kodwa ngoku ningukukhanya eNkosini. Pfilani njengabantwana bokukhanya.

readings.label: INdumiso Yokuphendula
readings.text:
R. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.
Onethemba umntu ongahambiyo ngokweengcebiso zabanqolobi, ongemiyo ezindleleni zaboni, nongahlaliyo phakathi kwabagculeli,
Kodwa owonwaba ngumthetho kaYehova, ozilolonga emthethweni wakhe imini nobusuku.
R. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.
Unjengomthi otyalwe ngasecaleni kwamanzi ayechumayo, ovelisa iziqhamo zawo ngexesha lawo, namagqabi awo angaphelelwayo.
Nakuphi na akwenzayo kuyaphumelela.
R. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.
Akunjalo kwabanqolobi, akunjalo; banjengothuli olugxothwa ngumoya.
Kuba uYehova uyazibona iindlela zamalungelo, ke yona indlela yabanqolobi iyatshabalala.
R. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wayefundisa kwindlu yesabatha. Kwakukho umfazi owayegobe iminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo ngenxa yomoya omubi; wayegobekile, engenakukwazi ukuma ngqo konke konke. UYesu rixa wambonayo, wambiza wathi kuye: 'Wazihlangula esifweni sakho.' Wambeka izandla zakhe, wathi kwangoko wama ngqo waza wazukisa uThixo. Kodwa umphathi wendlu yesabatha, ecaphukile ngokuba uYesu ephilisile ngesabatha, wathi esizweni: ' Zikhona iintsuku eziyisithandathu ekufuneka kusetyenzwe ngazo; yizani ngazo ezo zuku ukuze niphiliswe, hayi ngomhla wesabatha.' Nkosi yam wamphendula wathi: 'Zihamba ngobuqhetseba! Ngaba akukho namnye kuni othi ngesabatha athulule inkomo yakhe okanye esibaweni sakhe emkhombeni aye kuyiselza? Lo ntshabalalo ka-Abraham, owayeboshwe nguSathana iminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo, bekungafanele ukuba akhululwe ngomhla wesabatha kule ntsika?' Uthe akutsho oku, bonke abamchasi baseYoni baba neentloni; sonke isizwe savuya ngezenzo ezimangalisayo ezenziwa nguye.

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakukholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente Eyingcwele yaseAltar. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yomoya. Ndiya kukwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona apha, ndibumbane nawe ngokuphelele; musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlulwe nawe naphakade. Amen.
closing: UThixo uSomandla akusikelele akukhusele, akukhanyisele ngobuso bakhe, akunike noxolo lwakhe. Amen.
day: Monday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
